old_caption: The video showcases a collection of metallic spheres arranged in various geometric formations on a plain white surface. A hand enters the frame from the left side, holding and slightly repositioning a long, linear formation. The hand then moves to the right side of the frame, where it picks up and repositions a small cube-like formation. Throughout the sequence, the hand continues to interact with different formations, holding and moving them while the rest of the formations remain static. The background remains consistent, providing a clean and uncluttered backdrop for the activity. The video focuses solely on the hand's actions and the movement of the metallic spheres, emphasizing the precision and methodical nature of the task.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a collection of metallic spheres arranged in various geometric formations on a plain white surface. A hand enters the frame from the left side, manipulating one of these formations into a cylindrical shape. The hand then moves to the right side of the frame, where another formation is similarly transformed into a cylinder. Throughout the sequence, the hand continues to interact with different formations, rearranging them into cylindrical shapes while the rest of the formations remain static. The background remains consistent, providing a clean and uncluttered backdrop for the activity. The video focuses solely on the hand's actions and the transformation of the metallic spheres, emphasizing the precision and methodical nature of the task.
caption: The video showcases a white tabletop scattered with many small cubic clusters of shiny metallic magnetic balls. At the left, a hand grips the near end of a diagonal bar that is already lengthening, its body sliding rightward while the far end sweeps up and merges with a nearby cluster, growing the short slab into a much longer bar. The remaining cubic clusters stay fixed throughout, indicating a stationary camera. The left hand then releases and exits, leaving the elongated bar resting in the upper-left. A right hand next enters at the upper-right, grasping a compact cluster and dragging it so the held end stays put while the opposite end stretches leftward into a new bar. This second stretching continues through the final frame.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
